name: devtool 0.3.2 compact HUD actions and focused failure copy
description: Complete devtool source repository with self-contained artifact metadata, atomic bundles, and disposable external validation scripts.
highlights: Artifact schema v2 inventory and repository identity
Embedded target, validation policy, and commit message
Atomic monorepo overlay bundles with dependency ordering
Disposable artifact validators executed from TMPDIR
CLI opt-outs for embedded validation, commit, and scripts
Compact-by-default GTK desktop HUD with persistent action buttons
Focused failure clipboard reports with concise successful-phase status
